683:t_010:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You could call it an $$エグゼリオ変動重力源$$, more or less.」

683:t_010:15.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Our world... created that $$変動重力源$$...」

683:t_010:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You needn't feel responsible for that.」

683:t_010:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「If anything is to blame, it is the force that seeks to vanish, which evolved the $$宇宙怪獣$$ across parallel worlds for the sake of the universe's great collapse.」

683:t_010:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What do you want to do? Did you come to tell us what the $$宇宙怪獣$$ really are?」

683:t_010:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Here is the answer.」

683:t_011:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now... black emissary. Punish the humans of Earth.」

683:t_011:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「You'd attack us here and now!?」

683:t_011:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't you care if the universe gets destroyed!?」

683:t_011:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We will decide the universe's fate anew ourselves. And to us, you matter more than the existence of $$バアル$$.」

683:t_011:5.en:
???
「Is that all, $$喜びのアドヴェント$$?」

683:t_012:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「By deliberately taking the power of the $$御使い$$, I mastered how to use the four $$スフィア$$s.」

683:t_012:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

683:t_012:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「My thanks, Advent. You truly are the original owner of the $$スフィア$$s, and the oldest higher-dimensional life form...」

683:t_012:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And indeed, one of the $$御使い$$ who burdened me with a cursed destiny.」

683:t_012:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Are you saying the $$御使い$$ are the ones who made that bastard immortal, too!?」

683:t_012:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「How pitiful, $$アサキム$$. By feeding the power of my $$ヘリオース$$ back into yourself, you became one with the $$スフィア$$s.」

683:t_012:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That's right! And so the black wings overcome destiny and atone for Heaven's sin!」

683:t_016:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$. You dared to take $$ブルー$$'s life.」

683:t_016:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Drop the tedious act, Advent. There is no heat in your anger.」

683:t_016:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What a man you are...!」

683:t_016:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Even so, you still seem to want to keep them from setting foot in your own universe.」

683:t_016:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's here at the galactic center. The entrance to the universe where they live.」

683:t_016:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム$$ is right.」

683:t_016:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「At the galactic center of the Milky Way Galaxy stands a pillar that pierces all parallel worlds... the $$天柱$$.」

683:t_016:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「To put it in terms you can understand, it is an elevator for traveling between the floors that are the parallel worlds.」

683:t_016:13.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Something that pierces all parallel worlds... the $$天柱$$...」

683:t_016:14.en:
$$桂$$
「The universe's great collapse, once every 120 million years...! Does it happen through that $$天柱$$!?」

683:t_016:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Exactly, $$始原の特異点$$s. You instinctively sensed where your sin lies.」

683:t_016:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But to pass through it, you need enough power to transcend the laws of this universe. It is not something you can do anything about just because you know of it.」

683:t_016:17.en:
$n
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Are you running away!?」

683:t_016:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am always watching over you. Yes, and I will continue to.」

683:t_016:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Farewell, $c. I await the day you pass through the $$天柱$$.」

683:t_017:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Screw you! How much more do you have to look down on us before you're satisfied!」

683:t_017:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Stop! Right now, dealing with that giant $$変動重力源$$ comes first!」

683:t_018:0.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$エグゼリオ変動重力源$$...!」

683:t_018:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「If we don't take that thing down, we can't save the universe!」

683:t_018:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「We can't stop the $$時空震動弾$$ from going off! If we can't take it down before then, the operation fails!」

683:t_018:3.en:
$$アスラン$$
「And on top of the $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$, we have to deal with that monster...!」

683:t_018:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You seem to lack confidence.」

683:t_018:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't make me laugh, $$アサキム$$.」

683:t_018:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「No matter what enemy shows up, we swore to fight to the end!」

683:t_018:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Dealing with you can wait. Be good and stay out of the way.」

683:t_018:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No... I'll fight alongside you.」

683:t_018:10.en:
$$シン$$
「Quit screwing around! Who'd ever borrow your power!」

683:t_018:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'm not lending you a hand. I fight for the universe too... that's all there is to it.」

683:t_018:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... I can't trust you.」

683:t_018:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But just this once, I'll borrow that power, too.」

683:t_018:15.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then it's settled. Let's do this!」

683:t_018:16.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Our target is the $$エグゼリオ変動重力源$$!」

683:t_018:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The point to attack is that spot over there!」

683:t_019:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I'll break it down from that one point...!」

683:t_019:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「No matter how huge the enemy, as long as it's alive, it can surely be defeated!」

683:t_019:2.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Let's go, everyone! If we staked everything on the fight until a moment ago...」

683:t_019:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then from here on, it's a fight beyond our limits!」

683:t_019:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'll do it! If there's victory beyond that!!」

683:t_019:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I'll do it! If there's victory beyond that!!」

683:t_019:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「I'll do it! If there's victory beyond that!!」

683:t_020:0.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「As expected of an outrageous monster! It won't go down easily!」

683:t_020:1.en:
$$シベラ$$
「A fleet is approaching from the rear! This is... reinforcements from Earth!」

683:t_020:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「The second wave of the Galactic Raid Fleet! You made it!」

天柱.evidence: Advent: the pillar at the galactic center piercing all parallel worlds, an elevator between worlds; not in glossary (also appears in 2099_08/2100_00); written as plain English

kept_omissions: 683:t_018:3: アンゲロイ・アルカもいるというのに あの化け物を…！ (verb dropped in source; supplied 'we have to deal with')
uncertain: 天柱 = 'Heavenly Pillar' (plain English, no glossary entry; 2099_08 and 2100_00 also use it - keep consistent). Alternative 'Celestial Pillar'.
683:t_011:1 黒き使者 rendered singular 'black emissary' (Angeloi Arca is singular in t_018:3); plural possible.
683:t_011:5 speaker ??? (pid_ASA, line names 喜びのアドヴェント; Asakim replies-as t_012:0 Setsuko says Asakim) - used token $$喜びのアドヴェント$$ (Advent of Joy, proposed in sheet).
683:t_016:3/4 自らの宇宙: 'your own universe' (Asakim to Advent) / Roger 'Their own universe?' - referent of 自ら ambiguous.
683:t_018:4 レイ = Rey ($$レイ#pt136$$, male, with Athrun/Shinn) - not Rei Ayanami.
683:t_013:1 取った！ = 'Got you!' (Asakim strikes Advent; Blue shields).
Honorific 様 dropped in Blue's 'Advent!' (t_013:2, t_014:0).
683:t_019:2/3 Kazumi/Noriko conditional split: 'Then' added in Noriko's line to complete the sentence.
683:t_012:9 天罪 = 'Heaven's sin', 宿命 = 'destiny' (Asakim's catchphrase; check against other slices).
